stake_amount_gwei.meaning: amount staked by the normal user, reported as the minimum allowed 10 gwei

tiny_op_amount_8dec.meaning: amount of the tiny L1 operation created by the queued withdrawal, reported as 1 in 8 decimals

bridge_rejects_tiny_op.meaning: the L1 bridge rejects the tiny L1 operation amount
bridge_rejects_tiny_op.checkpoint: during L1 bridge processing of the tiny operation

pending_withdrawals_exist.meaning: other users have pending withdrawal requests in the L1 operations queue
pending_withdrawals_exist.checkpoint: before the tiny operation is processed

subsequent_ops_blocked.meaning: all subsequent L1 operations in the queue are blocked

assumptions: The tiny L1 operation is processed at the queue position such that other users' pending withdrawals are subsequent operations.
The L1 bridge rejection of the tiny amount is a realistic production behavior that can occur.
kHYPE burn timing relative to queue processing is not modeled.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish that the tiny operation is the first/next in queue order relative to other pending withdrawals, so the ordering needed for 'subsequent operations blocked' is not fully grounded.

limitations: Formalizes only the queue-blocking impact i_queue_blocked; fund loss and trapped ETH impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The blocked-queue outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric queue-length or index definition.
Bridge rejection is treated as a potential event per the report, not an observed one.
